newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain's Prosegur interim dividend up 5 pct.
newsitem.headline: Spain's Prosegur interim dividend up 5 pct.

text.p: Spanish security firm Prosegur said on Friday it would pay a 1996 gross interim dividend of 12.6 pesetas per share, a five percent increase on last year.
In a statement the company said the dividend would be payable on March 10.
In October the insurance company split its capital, reducing the nominal value of its shares to 100 pesetas each from 500 pesetas.
On a pre-split basis this year's interim dividend equates to 63 pesetas per share, compared with last year's 60 pesetas per share.
